text: Order now and enjoy fresh roasts, handcrafted drinks, and artisan snacks — all just a click away.

heading: text
Heading
Exceptional Coffee Starts with Exceptional Quality
body:
We pride ourselves on providing only quality, specialty coffees. As coffee enthusiasts, we've decided we have let too many years pass by drinking ordinary coffee.

Unlike most other coffees you find in big box stores, Sweet Eye Coffee was founded with freshness and quality at its foundation. Every batch is carefully selected and roasted to order!

Coffee beans are actually seeds from coffee cherries grown all over the world. Different origins produce varying flavors based on climate, altitude, and harvesting methods. Sweet Eye Coffee imports only Grade A specialty beans that are thoroughly inspected for defects before roasting.

heading: text
Heading
Roasted to Order
body:
A key differentiator is our "roast-to-order" approach. Unlike mass-market supermarket coffee roasted months or years in advance, Sweet Eye roasts each batch only after customers place orders, ensuring maximum freshness and vibrant flavors.

With all variations of roasts and grinds available, you'll find a coffee you call yours. There are no shortcuts around quality.

heading: text
Heading
What Sets Us Apart
item1_text: We select premium, specialty-grade beans from the ripest cherries across the world's finest growing regions.
item2_text: Every batch is small-batch roasted fresh to order, never sitting on shelves for months like store-bought coffee.
item3_text: Only Grade A specialty beans make the cut. Every bean is thoroughly inspected for defects before roasting.

text:
## 1. Introduction

Sweet Eye Coffee Roasters ("we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of our customers. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website, place an order, or interact with us in any way. By using our website, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

## 2. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

### Personal Information

- Full name
- Email address
- Phone number
- Shipping and billing address
- Payment information (processed securely through our payment processor)
- Account credentials (if you create an account)

### Automatically Collected Information

- IP address and browser type
- Device information and operating system
- Pages visited, time spent, and navigation patterns
- Referring website or source
- Cookies and similar tracking technologies

## 3. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect for the following purposes:

- To process and fulfill your orders, including shipping and delivery
- To communicate with you about your orders, account, or inquiries
- To send promotional emails, newsletters, and special offers (with your consent)
- To improve our website, products, and customer experience
- To detect and prevent fraud or unauthorized activity
- To comply with legal obligations

## 4. How We Share Your Information

We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share your information with:

- **Service providers:** Payment processors, shipping carriers, email marketing platforms, and website hosting services that help us operate our business
- **Legal compliance:** When required by law, regulation, or legal process
- **Business transfers:** In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets

## 5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. These include:

- **Essential cookies:** Required for core website functionality such as shopping cart and checkout
- **Analytics cookies:** Help us understand how visitors interact with our website
- **Marketing cookies:** Used to deliver relevant advertisements and measure campaign effectiveness

You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

## 6. Data Security

We implement commercially reasonable security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption of sensitive data during transmission (SSL/TLS), secure payment processing, and restricted access to personal data. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## 7. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Order records are retained for accounting and tax purposes as required by law.

## 8. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:

- Access the personal data we hold about you
- Request correction of inaccurate information
- Request deletion of your personal data
- Opt out of marketing communications at any time
- Request a copy of your data in a portable format

To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at [support@sweeteyecoffee.com](mailto:support@sweeteyecoffee.com).

## 9. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those websites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party sites you visit.

## 10. Children's Privacy

Our website is not directed to individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware that we have collected information from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete that information promptly.

## 11. Changes to This Policy

We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Last updated" date. Your continued use of our website after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.

## 12. Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

**Sweet Eye Coffee Roasters**  
1140 N Germantown Pkwy Ste 115  
Cordova, TN 38016  
Email: [support@sweeteyecoffee.com](mailto:support@sweeteyecoffee.com)

## 1. Our Satisfaction Guarantee

At Sweet Eye Coffee Roasters, we take great pride in the quality of our coffee. Every batch is carefully selected, roasted to order, and inspected before shipping. Your satisfaction is important to us, and we stand behind the quality of our products. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, please review the guidelines below.

## 2. Eligibility for Refunds

We offer refunds or replacements under the following circumstances:

- **Damaged products:** Items that arrive damaged, broken, or in unusable condition during shipping
- **Incorrect orders:** If you receive the wrong product, roast level, or grind type
- **Quality issues:** Products that are defective or do not meet our stated quality standards
- **Missing items:** If items from your order are missing upon delivery

## 3. Refund Request Timeline

To be eligible for a refund, you must contact us within **14 days** of receiving your order. Requests made after this period may not be eligible for a refund or replacement. Please contact us as soon as possible after discovering any issue with your order.

## 4. How to Request a Refund

To initiate a refund or replacement, please contact us with the following information:

- Your order number
- The email address used to place the order
- A description of the issue
- Photos of the damaged or incorrect product (if applicable)

Send your request to [support@sweeteyecoffee.com](mailto:support@sweeteyecoffee.com) with the subject line "Refund Request - [Your Order Number]." Our team will review your request and respond within 2-3 business days.

## 5. Refund Options

Once your refund request is approved, we will offer one of the following resolutions:

- **Full refund:** A refund to the original payment method for the affected item(s)
- **Replacement:** A complimentary replacement shipment of the correct or undamaged product
- **Store credit:** Credit applied to your account for future purchases

The resolution offered will depend on the nature of the issue and product availability.

## 6. Non-Refundable Items

Due to the perishable nature of coffee and food safety considerations, the following are generally not eligible for refunds:

- Products that have been opened and partially consumed where the complaint is based on personal taste preference
- Orders where the customer provided an incorrect shipping address
- Products not purchased directly from our website
- Gift cards or promotional items

## 7. Shipping Costs

If the refund or replacement is due to our error (wrong item, damaged product, or quality issue), we will cover all return shipping costs and reship at no additional charge. If you wish to return a product for any other reason, shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer and original shipping fees are non-refundable.

## 8. Refund Processing Time

Once approved, refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days. The refund will be credited to the original payment method used at checkout. Please note that it may take an additional 3-5 business days for the refund to appear on your bank or credit card statement, depending on your financial institution.

## 9. Order Cancellations

Because our coffee is roasted to order, we begin processing orders promptly. If you need to cancel an order, please contact us as soon as possible. Orders that have not yet entered the roasting process can be cancelled for a full refund. Once roasting has begun, the order cannot be cancelled, but you may be eligible for a return under the terms outlined above.

## 10. Exchanges

We handle exchanges on a case-by-case basis. If you would like to exchange a product for a different roast, blend, or grind type, please contact us and we will do our best to accommodate your request. Exchanges are subject to product availability and may involve additional shipping charges.

## 11. Contact Us

If you have any questions about our Refund Policy or need assistance with an order, please do not hesitate to reach out:
